title: Brazilian Cream Puffs
description: Delicate cream-filled pastries with a nutty twist, inspired by Brazilian cuisine. These puffs are perfect for a sweet dessert or snack.
instructions: Cut nutty biscuits into small squares.
In a separate bowl, whip glassy jelly until smooth.
In another bowl, whip brazilian cream until stiff peaks form.
Fold crushed oreo into the whipped cream.
Assemble cream puffs by placing a square of nutty biscuits on a baking sheet, topping with a spoonful of jelly, and finishing with a dollop of cream mixture.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Allow puffs to cool before serving.
